title: Klein 4B and Klein 9B are two different models, not two tiers of one - name them what people call them
description: Both Klein cards are literally named "FLUX.2 Klein", so every surface tells them apart with a sizeTier letter (L/B) invented for genuine tier variants. Klein is not a tier variant: 4B and 9B are distinct models the public knows by those names, with incompatible LoRAs. Fabio, 2026-08-25: "People know these models by their name, which is extremely confusing for a user who already heard about Klein 4B and Klein 9B." Rename to "FLUX.2 Klein 4B" / "FLUX.2 Klein 9B". The clash-gated letters then vanish on their own. Boogu and LTX stay on the letter - they ARE tier variants.
